question.text: If <math><mi>M</mi></math> and <math><mi>m</mi></math> are the maximum and minimum values of <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></math> for pair of real numbers <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> which satisfy the equation <math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></math>, then the value of <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow></mfrac></math> is

solution.text:
Let yx=m'. So, on putting y= m ′ x in the given circle,
We get x−3 2 + m ′ x−3 2 =6
⇒x21+m'2-6x1+m'+12=0
Putting discriminant =0, we get,
m'=3+_22
So, m = 3-22 and M=3+22⇒mM=1
⇒1M+1m=m+M
=3-22+3+22
=6
